notes: Cases are ordered for walk-forward evaluation: earlier cases form the selection fold, later cases the held-out fold that decides champion/challenger verdicts (#1140). Structures use the catalog snake_case ids so scores join to strategy weights. P&L estimates are the intrinsic-value heuristic of runResearchEvaluation, not fill records.
provenance: Synthetic held-out fixtures for champion/challenger promotion evaluation (#1140, epic #1096 Phase 5), extending the #583 versioned-dataset mechanism. These are NOT production runs; they exist so promotion gates are exercised deterministically against a frozen set.
